hook: The essential p-dimension of PGL(p^n) is p^(2n-2)+1, settling a long-open count.
summary: The paper determines the essential p-dimension of central simple algebras of degree p^n, giving p^(2n-2)+1 for PGL(p^n), which extends Merkurjev's case n=2. The lower bounds apply a theorem of Ofek to block centralizers. As a consequence, it constructs exponent-p division algebras that stay noncrossed products, but only for degrees p^n with n at least 3 (4 when p=2).
title: Essential $p$-dimension of simple algebras and noncrossed products of prime exponent
